title: Telegram CEO reportedly under criminal probe in Russia over alleged terrorism links
summary: Russian authorities reportedly claim the Telegram messenger refused to remove 155,000 channels flagged for illegal content.

title: Hashgraph Group launches Hedera-based tool for EU digital product passports
summary: Hashgraph has launched a blockchain-based supply-chain traceability solution ahead of the EU’s Digital Product Passport requirements, some of which take effect beginning in 2027.

title: Bitcoin market enters full capitulation as price dips below $63K
summary: Panic selling by short-term holders, combined with the RSI near record lows, suggests that BTC could be transitioning into a full capitulation regime.

title: Bitcoin ETF sell-off is ‘purification’ of bull case, investor says
summary: Bitcoin ETF investors have recorded sustained outflows this year, but EMJ Capital’s Eric Jackson argues a longer-term institutional buyer base could emerge.

title: Coinbase USDC revenue may multiply 7x as payments grow, Bloomberg says
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence said Coinbase’s USDC revenue may jump sevenfold, as Congress weighs a ban on stablecoin rewards that could reshape how that money is earned.

title: RedotPay weighs US IPO that could raise $1B at over $4B valuation: Report
summary: RedotPay secured $194 million in 2025 across three funding rounds, reaching a valuation above $1 billion and drawing backing from crypto- and venture-focused investors.

title: Canaan buys 49% stake in three Texas mining sites for $40M
summary: Canaan has acquired a stake in three operating Texas mining facilities with 120 MW of power and 4.4 EH/s of hashrate, expanding its footprint in infrastructure operations.

title: Crypto VC Framework Ventures to help Better with $500M DeFi play
summary: Framework reportedly struck a $45 million deal to acquire 10% of Better and will help it launch a token on the crypto protocol Sky.

title: Cybersecurity stocks fall after Anthropic unveils Claude Code Security
summary: Anthropic’s Claude Code Security sent shockwaves through cybersecurity markets, with CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks among the hardest hit.

title: TRM Labs, Finray Technologies partner for crypto and fiat monitoring
summary: The system provides real-time risk alerts for suspicious crypto transactions across multiple blockchains within the same workflow as fiat-payment monitoring.
